spec.field_join: LF; array elements joined by LF; preserve order, duplicates and empty strings
spec.field_weights: NONE; every token occurrence has unit TF weight
spec.tokenizer: ASCII camel boundaries (?<=[a-z0-9])(?=[A-Z])|(?<=[A-Z])(?=[A-Z][a-z]); Unicode [^\W_]+ runs; str.lower
spec.digits: retained within runs; no letter/digit split except digit-to-ASCII-uppercase camel boundary
spec.normalization: NONE; no NFC, casefold, stopwords, stemming, expansion, whole-identifier augmentation or truncation
spec.query_terms: unique terms sorted by Python Unicode code-point order; no query TF weight
spec.tf: token occurrence count in concatenated method document
spec.df: number of all catalog documents containing the term
spec.idf: ln(1 + (N - df + 0.5)/(df + 0.5)); natural log via log1p
spec.length: dl includes all document tokens; avgdl=sum(dl)/N including empty documents
spec.empty: empty query/document or avgdl=0 gives zero scores; N=0 gives EMPTY
spec.order: descending unrounded finite binary64 score, then original catalog ordinal ascending
spec.real_case_execution: DISABLED; fixture-* only; no tuning on the four real cases
